Mud-Slap (Japanese: どろかけ Mud Spray), formatted Mud Slap in Pokémon GO, is a damage-dealing Ground-type move introduced in Generation II. It was TM31 in Generation II.

Effect

Generation II

Mud-Slap inflicts damage and has a 99.6% chance of lowering the target's accuracy stat by one stage.

Generation III onwards

Mud-Slap now always lowers the target's accuracy by one stage.

Mud-Slap can also be used as part of a Pokémon Contest combination, with the user gaining extra four appeal points if any of the moves Mud Sport, Sand-Attack or Sandstorm was used in the prior turn. It can also be used to start a combination, causing the base appeal of Mud Sport and Sand-Attack to be doubled if used in the next turn.

In the anime

Barbaracle Murkrow Drilbur Krookodile
The user hurls mud in the foe's face.
Pokémon Method
User First Used In Notes
Murkrow Murkrow turns around and kicks up clumps of mud at the opponent.
Three wild Murkrow All That Glitters! Debut
Drilbur Drilbur slams both of its claws into the ground and pulls them up, throwing two balls of brown mud at the opponent.
Iris's Drilbur Iris and Excadrill Against the Dragon Buster! None
Barbaracle Barbaracle slams both of its claws into the ground, causing two streams of brown mud to shoot out of the ground and hit the opponent.
Saizo's Barbaracle A Stealthy Challenge! None
Krookodile Krookodile fires a stream of brown mud from its mouth at the or it breathes in air through its nostrils and then shoots multiple projectiles of mud from its nostrils at the opponent.
Mantle's Krookodile Rotom's Wish! None
Nanu's Krookodile Tough Guy Trials! None

  • In the preview for the unaired AG101, Chōta's Barboach is seen using Mud-Slap.
  • In Camping It Up!, it was revealed by Dawn's Pokedex that the Grimer she used at the Pokémon Summer Academy knew Mud-Slap. However, it was never seen using the move.
